review.why: Searches public X posts, trends, profiles and replies through the AgentBody API, read-only.
review.summary: Read-only command center for current X data: search, trends, post, profile, profile posts, media and comments through seven fixed AgentBody routes and a bundled client script. It preserves URLs, authors, timestamps and cursors, never invents data, and spells out the missing-key and insufficient-balance cases.
strengths: Read-only: no write or account management operations
Never invents posts, IDs or engagement counts
Handles credentials and account states explicitly
cautions: Tied to the AgentBody service, which needs a paid account
Tells the agent to prefer it over the browser and built-in web search
Reads the key from several local files and environment locations
